items.title: SMS alerts helped avert loss of life in Budhi Gandaki floods, says disaster management chief
items.blurb: Dharmaraj Uprety says early warnings prompted residents to move to higher ground, while the flood swept away bridges and damaged settlements and hydropower infrastructure.

items.title: ‘It reminded me of the Bhotekoshi floods’: Gorkha residents recount escape
items.blurb: A flash flood in the Budhi Gandaki swept away houses and bridges early Sunday, forcing residents of Chumnubri and Dharche to flee to higher ground in the dark. Five people are missing, and six have been rescued by air.

items.title: Five things to know about the Budhi Gandaki flash flood
items.blurb: An estimated 35 to 40 houses and several bridges have been swept away in Gorkha, while a suspected landslide may have triggered the flooding. Five people have been reported missing as rescue efforts continue.

items.title: Bailey bridge restores road link between Rasuwa and Nuwakot after six weeks
items.blurb: A 73-metre bridge over the Phalakhu river has reopened the route between the two districts, whose road connection was severed by floods in August.

items.title: Landslide may have triggered flash flooding in Budhi Gandaki, officials say
items.blurb: A landslide in Chumchet may have blocked a tributary before water surged downstream. Authorities warn of high flood risks along the Trishuli river as far as Chitwan and Nawalparasi.

items.title: Four people unaccounted for after Budhi Gandaki floods
items.blurb: The four locals were living in a shed on the banks of the Ungilung river in Chumchet, Gorkha.

items.title: What we know so far about the damage caused by Budhi Gandaki floods
items.blurb: Flooding has swept away houses and bridges in Gorkha’s Chumnubri and Dharche rural municipalities, while a hydropower project’s construction site has also been damaged. The full extent of the damage remains unclear.

items.title: Budhi Gandaki flood washes away three bridges in Gorkha
items.blurb: Two suspension footbridges and a steel bridge have been swept away, while several houses have been destroyed or inundated, Nepal Police say.

items.title: Flood sweeps away houses, bridges in Gorkha
items.blurb: Helicopters deployed for rescue and evacuations as rising waters force residents and tourists to flee.

items.title: Smuggling networks exploit Nepal’s open border to flood markets with untaxed goods
items.blurb: From sugar and fertiliser to clothes, mobile phones and medicines, illicit consignments continue to enter Nepal through southern border crossings, depriving the state of revenue and undercutting legitimate traders.

items.title: Damaged highways disrupt Dashain travel, airlines prepare late-night flights
items.blurb: With over a million people expected to leave Kathmandu Valley by road, the collapse of a section of the Prithvi Highway has stranded travellers and forced authorities to expand transport arrangements.

items.title: Selective buying offers little lift to Nepse as turnover declines
items.blurb: Banking shares gained, and hydropower stocks dominated trading, but weak turnover and losses across most sectors point to limited investor confidence.
